description: Returns one Customermates documentation page as markdown, with its canonical URL. Links into the app in the docs are full URLs on this instance and open the reader's own workspace. Required: slug. Optional: locale (one of: en, de, fr, it, es, pt, pl, nl; default en), source (one of: docs, api; default docs), anchor, query. A nonempty section anchor returns that section, and query then focuses its content. Without anchor and query the full page is returned; query alone returns a bounded excerpt focused on that detail. An unknown slug returns the valid slugs.

anchor.description: Exact nonempty section anchor, as returned in the anchor of a documentation search hit; pins that section while query focuses its content

query.description: Exact question or detail to return as a focused excerpt; may be combined with anchor. A section anchor is also accepted for existing clients

slug.description: Docs page slug, e.g. 'quickstart' or 'mcp' (the MCP tool catalog is on 'mcp')

source.description: docs = product guides, api = REST endpoint reference

name: get_docs_page

excerpt.description: True when markdown is a section or query-focused excerpt rather than the full page

markdown.description: The focused excerpt when query or anchor was passed, otherwise the full page

title: Get documentation page
